j101.text: Last time, we planted a mango seed, and we observed it like a scientist. It grew into a young plant. But will our young plant ever grow mangoes?

j201a.text: A little weaver ant is hiding in this video. Can you spot it?

j201b.text: It is very small, and it hides somewhere new each time. Look along the leaves and the branches!

j201c.text: Lock in first with your fingers. One finger for every point.

j401.text: Round one. This old mango tree is covered in tiny flowers. Which stage is it in? One, the seed. Two, the young plant. Three, the adult plant. Show me with your fingers.

j403.text: Two. It still grows new leaves, so I think it is a young plant.

j404.text: Three! Our young plant has no flowers, but this tree does. So it is an adult plant!

j405.text: Three! A plant with flowers must be all grown up.

j501.text: Look closer. Here is our young plant, beside the old tree.

j503b.text: Our young plant has a thin stem, but the old tree has a thick trunk and lots of tiny flowers!

j504p.text: But look at the tips. The old tree has new red leaves too, so it is still growing.

j506.text: The young plant grew into an adult plant. The adult plant started to have flowers and fruits.

j507b.text: Adult plants keep growing too. But only a grown-up plant, an adult plant, has flowers and fruits!

j508.text: The answer is three: the adult plant! Three fingers? One finger up!

j601m.text: But where do new mango seeds come from?

j602b.text: From the roots! The tree pushes them out, under the ground.

j603.text: Let's find out. Be a mango flower! Shrink down. Quietly.

j701.text: You are a tiny flower on the big mango tree. Your petals fall, and you start to grow into a tiny green mango.

j703.text: Week after week, you grow bigger and heavier. Inside you, a seed grows, big and flat.

j704.text: You turn yellow and sweet. You are a ripe mango, with a new seed inside!

j801b.text: Oops! The new seeds grow inside the fruits, not in the roots!

j803p.text: Let me put them on our board. The seed, then the young plant, then the adult plant, and its fruits bring new seeds.

j804.text: So a plant's life cycle goes round and round, and it has three stages.

j807.text: There are three stages in the life cycle of a plant. The stages are the seed, the young plant and the adult plant.

j901.text: Showdown! Double points. Momo's homework has one mistake. Line one, two, or three? Show me with your fingers.

j902.text: Here is my homework! Three: the adult plant is the last stage, and the cycle ends.

j904.text: Three! The adult plant has fruits with new seeds, so round it goes again!

j905p.text: Three. A life cycle goes round and round, so there is no last stage.

j906.text: The stages in a life cycle are repeated. There is no first or last stage.

j907.text: Three fingers? Put up two more on your score hand!

j1001m.text: But what if a kind of plant had no more seeds at all?

j1002b.text: Easy! Then we just buy more seeds at the shop!

j1004.text: Life cycles repeat to ensure that living things continue to live. With no seeds, that kind of plant could disappear.

j1005.text: Look closer. In 2019, Singapore opened its first seed bank, at the Botanic Gardens.

j1006p.text: Scientists dry the seeds, and they keep them in jars with labels.

j1007b.text: Then the jars go into a very cold room, like a giant freezer, so the seeds can wait for many years!

j1102.text: A seed bank stores seeds safely until they are needed.

c1003.text: Seed, young plant! Adult plant! Flowers, fruits! Seeds inside! No first, no last! Round and round!

j1201.text: Show me your score hand! More than one? You beat the Buddies. Three fingers? High five!

j1202.text: Did you spot the weaver ant? It was on a leaf of the old mango tree!

j1203.text: Here is a fun fact! Weaver ants sew leaves together to make their nest, and the sticky thread comes from their own babies! They live in mango trees, high up in their leaf nests.

j1301.text: Next time: a tadpole! It lives in water, and it has a tail. What will it grow into? One, a fish. Two, a frog. Three, a lizard. Lock in your answer!

h860.text: Let's read today's key words together! Ready?
